info.name: Annie Hartnett Author Event
info.description:
Annie Hartnett is the bestselling author of three award-winning novels: Rabbit Cake, Unlikely Animals, and The Road to Tender Hearts. Her latest novel, The Road to Tender Hearts, won the 2025 New England Book Award for fiction. Annie currently lives in Massachusetts with her husband, daughter, and dog.

Annie will be visiting Mounce on Saturday, August 22nd for a presentation, Q&A, and book signing. This event is free to attend, and you can find more details and register at https://www.bcslibrary.org/programs/author-series/.

**This event is happening at Clara B. Mounce Library and NOT Hyperbole Bookstore.**

Hyperbole Bookstore's monthly thriller book club is open to all adult readers! For July, we are reading Pretty Dead Things by Kelsey Cox, a tense and twisty psychological thriller. Join us at Downtown Uncorked for beverages, books, and bountiful conversation. Downtown Uncorked is located in south College Station at 1551 Greens Prairie Road, Suite 102. This month's book is 15% off both in store and online. Reserve your copy today!

info.name: Threshing Day Release Party
info.description:
The next book in the bestselling Empyrean series by Rebecca Yarros arrives on September 29th, so join us at Hyperbole Bookstore on September 28th at 10 PM to count down the minutes until the official release of Threshing Day. This deluxe first edition features thirteen original stories set on Threshing Day as well as brand new full-color art. The book is available to pre-order now through our website (which we strongly encourage!!).

We are not allowed to sell the book until 11 PM, but you can expect snacks, trivia, and plenty of other Fourth Wing fans to socialize with as we await Threshing Day. We'll be opening the doors at 10 PM, and non-reserved books will be reserved on a first-come, first-serve basis if you haven't pre-ordered. It will likely be crowded, so please leave your human and furry children at home for this one.

info.name: Sarah Beth Durst Author Visit
info.description:
Sarah Beth Durst is the New York Times bestselling author of over 25 books for adults, teens and kids, including cozy fantasy, The Spellshop. She’s been awarded the American Library Association’s Alex Award, the Libby Book Award for Best Fantasy, and the Mythopoeic Fantasy Award. She lives in Stony Brook, New York, with her husband, her children, and her ill-mannered cat.

Sarah will be visiting Ringer Library on Wednesday, October 14th for a presentation, Q&A, and book signing. This event is free to attend, and you can find more details and register at https://www.bcslibrary.org/programs/author-series/.
